{"id":1848477378,"question_id":4089,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765034961,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"99 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1848477378/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximize Points After Choosing K Tasks","memory":"228.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long maxPoints(vector<int>& technique1, vector<int>& technique2, int k) {\n        vector<long long>gain;\n        for(int i=0; i<technique1.size() ; i++){\n            gain.push_back((long long)technique1[i] - technique2[i]);\n        }\n        sort(gain.rbegin() , gain.rend());\n        \n        long long totaltech2 = accumulate(technique2 .begin() , technique2.end() , 0LL);\n        long long x = 0;\n        for(int i =0; i<k ; i++){\n            totaltech2 += gain[i];\n        }\n\n        for(int i=k ; i < gain.size() ; i++){\n            if(gain[i] > 0) totaltech2 += gain[i];\n        }\n        return totaltech2;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximize-points-after-choosing-k-tasks","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1240}
